name: tracker-retry-receipt
goal: Persist a successful native retry and its earlier retry credit atomically without modifying retained legacy receipts.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Live MB2 smoke run 6 failed and run 7 called tracker done. The scheduler then failed every tick while trying to write the earlier run without advancing its version.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The dispatcher credit test uses a fixture ledger without production receipt revision checks. The existing SQLite repository case now exercises failed worker exit, managed retry, and preserved legacy history.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint 22e0d620d910 at 1064ef3557 failed with Tracker attempt version changed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Retry credit uses the shared version increment and applies only to revisioned local receipts. The SQLite regression fixture is unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged SQLite regression passed at e13e7efaa1 in the same sanitized runtime as red. Runtime measurements are stored in the green checkpoint.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
